title: Few-shot reactive-surface Mirror code
hypothesis: With a common frozen pretrained interatomic prior, a shared low-rank energy-readout basis plus a small per-surface code fitted from few reference structures reduces held-out reactive-region energy and force errors versus the frozen prior and approaches an equal-byte independent readout without storing one full readout per surface.
physical_object: Common frozen MACE-MP small interatomic potential weights
mirror_coordinate: Per-surface code m in delta_E = pooled_node_features @ B @ m; forces are negative coordinate gradients of this energy correction
logical_multiplicity: Few-shot calibrated surface/task-specific potential corrections over a shared basis

data.primary_split_source: NOMAD raw entries grouped by mainfile stage/facet/result-run path; do not use curated extxyz for primary fresh scoring

controls: PA301-style frozen-transfer/partial fine-tuning if executable and reproducible
shared low-rank basis plus per-surface Mirror code
independent task readout/private correction upper control when feasible
domain-trained H2/Cu checkpoint diagnostic only, excluded as common prior

development.selection_metric: Mean per-atom energy MAE and force component MAE on held-out development run groups; select rank and shot count only here.
development.burned_probe: 12 curated extxyz frames previously inspected; not used in primary stage-group split.

fresh.split_unit: Whole NOMAD result-run parent groups at mainfile path /<facet>/.../1_results/<run-id>/1_forces/aims.out; group all associated entries together.
fresh.selection: Preselect run IDs deterministically from metadata only, freeze manifest and hash before downloading any stage-6 raw files or reading metrics.

success_gate: On a preregistered fresh reactive-region set, few-shot shared-basis adaptation improves both energy and force errors over frozen prior; is within 5% of independent-readout quality; saves >=25% actual serialized adaptation bytes versus independent readouts; and adds <=20% inference compute/wall time.
failure_gate: No held-out quality improvement over frozen prior, failure of either energy/force gate, failure of 25% payload savings, >20% compute/time penalty, or exact same-rank native control alias (Mirror-specific attribution FAIL).
boundaries: The primary fresh split is the NOMAD stage 6 group; never tune on it.
The curated extxyz has no trajectory IDs and is excluded from primary split/scoring.
No explicit barrier labels; report held-out energy/force errors only unless complete reference paths are independently verified.
No generalized materials/catalyst claim from H2/Cu data.
Capacity is not established by fixed-update gains.

split_manifest.selection_rule: Per stage and facet, select first 8 complete result-run groups sorted by SHA256(MA-1003-v1|stage|facet|run_id), from metadata only. Stage 6 raw files and metrics unopened as of freeze.
split_manifest.role_group_counts: Exact selected groups and all member entry IDs/mainfiles are recorded in manifest.
